name: NHSBSA Open Data Portal
summary: NHS Business Services Authority open data on its CKAN portal, including Secondary Care Medicines Data (SCMD): hospital medicine usage by trust, month and product.
notes: Keyless. Every answer is a JSON envelope {success, result}; read result.

Two-step flow: package_show lists a dataset's resources (SCMD is one resource per month, named like SCMD_PROVISIONAL_202608); query a resource's rows with datastore_search or datastore_search_sql using its id or name.
SCMD datasets: secondary-care-medicines-data-indicative-price (provisional, with indicative cost) and others found with datasets.search.
datastore_search returns 100 rows by default and at most 32,000; page with offset.

endpoints.name: Search datasets
endpoints.summary: Datasets matching a Solr query, with their resources.

sort.description: Comma-separated field and order; default 'score desc, metadata_modified desc'.

rows.description: Datasets to return; default 10, at most 1000.

endpoints.name: Get a dataset and its resources
endpoints.summary: One dataset's description, licence and resources (monthly files), with ids and names.

endpoints.name: Search a resource's rows
endpoints.summary: Rows of one data resource, filtered, full-text searched, sorted and paged, with field types.

filters.description: JSON object of exact field matches, e.g. {"ODS_CODE": "RRV"}.

sort.description: Comma-separated field names with order, e.g. 'YEAR_MONTH desc'.

limit.description: Rows to return; default 100, at most 32000.

include_total.description: Return the total match count; default true.

endpoints.name: Query a resource with SQL
endpoints.summary: Rows from one SELECT statement over a data resource.

resource_id.description: Resource id or name the SQL reads.

sql.description: One SELECT statement; the table name goes in backticks.

notes: This portal refuses a table name that is not backtick-quoted, and refuses the call without resource_id.
Results stop at 32,000 rows; records_truncated is true when they did.
